purpose: A failed source/integrity check must not label a healthy embedder down; a true embedding failure must be observable and recover without restart or a permanently blocked v2 gate.

contract.typed_error: ckv.ErrEmbeddingFailed wraps query-vector generation/provider errors; errors.Is retains provider cause
contract.caller_context: caller-canceled/expired requests are not shared model failures; an active caller with a provider timeout is an embedding failure
contract.other_errors: source/integrity/store/budget/unknown errors neither set nor clear cached model evidence
contract.health: positive and negative observations expire after 5s; successful raw search clears a cached outage immediately; canceled probes do not mutate cache; empty probes are failures
contract.public_errors: semantic_search and v2 composition preserve bounded source_missing/snapshot_mismatch/embedding_failed/request_canceled/request_timeout codes; unknown semantic error retrieval_failed; gated v2 outage service_unavailable
contract.health_limit: model_reachable is cached liveness/usability, not proof all corpus sources are complete or every query succeeds

acceptance: targeted engine/adapter/MCP tests and full fresh build/test/race/fmt/vet/lint/boundaries/docs
same clean new binary actual MCP/real BGE-M3 via own faultable forwarding endpoint, never stop shared model server
old dataset real source_missing keeps model reachable and eligible known-good v2 query
new owned dataset missing/corrupt retained external blob yields specific error; model remains up and exact bytes restore
owned endpoint returns 503/empty embeddings -> embedding_failed and immediate cached down; v2 gate refuses
recover both through successful raw query and TTL health-only reprobe then v2, without restart
all attempts, request/wire/lifecycle, proxy observations, selected source/hash/model identities retained
normal EOF exit0/reap, own listener closed; original data/config/pointers/previous packets preserved
non_goals: startup-configured degraded dummy automatic client reconstruction
MCP cancellation notification implementation; context semantics are covered in native tests
